description: This file defines a custom JDesktopPane subclass (MDIDesktopPane) with enhanced MDI functionality, including window management, cascading, tiling, and scrollbar handling via a custom DesktopManager (MDIDesktopManager). It also contains inner classes for managing desktop resizing and scrollbars.

classes.name: MDIDesktopPane
classes.description: A subclass of JDesktopPane supporting enhanced MDI window management, including cascading, tiling, and scrollbar handling.

classes.name: MDIDesktopManager
classes.description: A custom DesktopManager for MDIDesktopPane that manages scrollbar resizing and desktop area adjustments during frame resize and drag operations.

methods.name: MDIDesktopPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the desktop manager and drag mode.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Overrides to check desktop size after bounds change.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JInternalFrame to the desktop, positioning it based on settings and existing frames, and initializes its size and visibility.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a component and updates toolbar and desktop size.

methods.name: cascadeFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a cascade pattern.

methods.name: tileFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a tiled pattern.

methods.name: setAllSize
methods.description: Sets minimum, maximum, and preferred size to a given Dimension or width/height.

methods.name: checkDesktopSize
methods.description: Checks and resizes desktop if necessary.
